annotations.title: Wait for the user to approve the PayPal payment

description: Wait (up to 45s per call) until PayPal reports the user approved the payment. Returns still_waiting if the user has not approved yet.

api_key.description: Sandbox key from create_checkout (not needed if the connection already carries one).
